claims: "Integrity" is the name given by the Artemis II crew to their Orion spacecraft.
"Integrity" was used as the radio callsign during the April 2026 mission.
Integrity served as the crew module for the Artemis II mission.
Integrity carried four astronauts on a 10-day mission around the Moon in April 2026.
The Artemis II mission set a record for the furthest humans have ever traveled into space.
Integrity was officially designated as the crewed spacecraft to return to Earth after looping around the Moon.
The Artemis II crew chose the name "Integrity" to honor the dedication and "integrity" of the thousands of people who worked to build and prepare the spacecraft.
The Artemis II crew named a lunar crater "Integrity".
